summary: Frontend testing completed for Diet Cafe web panel. Admin functionality works perfectly including login, dashboard stats, and shifts management. However, Staff PIN authentication (both Kitchen PIN 1234 and Cashier PIN 5678) remains non-functional, preventing testing of Kitchen and Cashier interfaces.
